claims.subject: tariffs
claims.mechanism: One-time price-level increase without lasting change to long-run inflation expectations.
claims.locator: Participants' Views on Current Conditions and the Economic Outlook, inflation paragraph
claims.test: Compare import prices, core goods and longer-run survey expectations after implementation; separate price level from persistent inflation.

claims.subject: tariffs
claims.mechanism: Tariff effects could persist and potentially affect inflation expectations.
claims.test: Persistent core goods price growth after direct cost shock fades, conditional on other shocks.

claims.subject: tariffs

claims.test: Employment, hiring and vacancies relative to independent baseline; cannot isolate tariffs by temporal sequence alone.

claims.subject: tariffs
claims.mechanism: Effects on core goods inflation expected to diminish; timing and degree of pass-through uncertain for some participants.
claims.test: Core goods inflation trajectory; comparison with prior tariff and import-cost changes.

claims.subject: tariffs
claims.mechanism: Higher tariffs had raised core inflation through goods prices; not an independently established causal estimate.

claims.subject: AI financing
claims.mechanism: If AI investment returns disappoint, debt growth, leasing commitments and circular funding may amplify losses.
claims.locator: Staff Review and Policymakers' Discussion of Financial Stability
claims.test: Aggregate debt, lease obligations, actual cash flow/coverage and losses, with verified source and denominator; conditional risk not a prediction of crash.

claims.subject: financial stability
claims.mechanism: Falling asset prices could induce deleveraging and redemption sales, worsening market functioning under severe scenarios.
claims.locator: Staff Review and Policymakers' Discussion of Financial Stability
claims.test: Measure fund flows, leverage and price impact on independent shocks; S2 overlap; no duplicate execution.
